response.query: What validation and audit protocols (image OCR, manual audits, manufacturer records) reliably detect net-content measurement error, inconsistent labels, and how to document unit-conversion provenance?
response.answer: Validation protocols include image OCR checks, manual audits, and manufacturer records to detect measurement errors and label inconsistencies. Document unit-conversion provenance through detailed records and cross-verification.

results.title: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act; HHS Notice of Benefit ...
results.content: It also provides additional amendments regarding the annual open enrollment period for the individual market for the 2017 and 2018 benefit years; essential health benefits; cost sharing; qualified health plans; Exchange consumer assistance programs; network adequacy; patient safety; the Small Business Health Options Program; stand-alone dental plans; third-party payments to qualified health plans; the definitions of large employer and small employer; fair health insurance premiums; student health insurance coverage; the rate review program; the medical loss ratio program; eligibility and enrollment; exemptions and appeals; and other related topics. (C) The employer may offer its qualified employees a choice of all QHPs offered through a Federally-facilitated SHOP by a single issuer across all available levels of coverage, as described in section 1302(d)(1) of the Affordable Care Act and implemented in § 156.140(b) of this subchapter.
